channel.title: Mikhbar — English
channel.description: Technology news covering AI, robotics, automation, mobile, computing, software, the web and digital platforms.

item.title: Google DeepMind Unveils SynthID Bio for Proteins
item.description: Google DeepMind introduces SynthID Bio, a new watermarking technology designed to embed imperceptible signatures into synthetic proteins and structures.

item.title: Innodata Opens Motion-Capture Lab for Robotics AI
item.description: Data engineering firm Innodata has launched a new motion-capture laboratory utilizing Vicon cameras to train humanoid robots and physical AI.

item.title: HydraFusion Research Preview Expands to VS Code and GitHub
item.description: GitHub expands its HydraFusion research preview beyond Copilot CLI, bringing multi-model orchestration capabilities to Visual Studio Code and the Copilot app.

item.title: NVIDIA Opens 2027–2028 Graduate Fellowships With $60K Awards
item.description: NVIDIA is now accepting worldwide applications for its 27th-year Graduate Fellowship Program, offering up to $60,000 in grants for doctoral students.

item.title: Build Multi-Agent Pipelines with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Learn how to build a multi-agent music production pipeline on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime Instances using shared sessions and GPU infrastructure.

item.title: Cloudflare Says Non-Human Web Traffic Exceeds 50% Amid AI Boom
item.description: Cloudflare reports that non-human web traffic has surpassed 50% for the first time, driven by a surge in AI agents and automated software requests.

item.title: Cisco Warns of New SD-WAN Zero-Day Exploited in Attacks
item.description: Cisco has released security updates to address a critical zero-day vulnerability in Catalyst SD-WAN Manager actively exploited by attackers.

item.title: Query Claims in Natural Language With Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Learn how to build a conversational claims assistant using Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to answer natural-language queries with citations.

item.title: OpenAI and America's SBDC Partner for Small Business AI Training
item.description: OpenAI announces a partnership with America's SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support, alongside a new report on small business usage.

item.title: NVIDIA and CoreWeave Launch Vera Rubin for Agentic AI
item.description: NVIDIA and CoreWeave announce the production availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems, accelerating agentic AI workflows and token throughput.

item.title: Cloudflare Releases AI Gateway Auto Router in Public Beta
item.description: Cloudflare launches its AI Gateway Auto Router in public beta, helping organizations cut AI token spending by up to 30 percent while maintaining performance.

item.title: Cloudflare Rebuilds Containers to Scale Agent Sandboxes
item.description: Cloudflare has rearchitected its Containers platform with 6x faster startup times, runtime image selection, and filesystem snapshots in public beta.

item.title: Cloudflare Updates AI Gateway With User Insights
item.description: Cloudflare has updated its AI Gateway tool with new User Insights features, helping teams analyze model overuse, task categories, and conversation turns.

item.title: Cloudflare Impact Reaches $100 Million in Donated Services
item.description: Cloudflare's Impact programs reach $100 million in donated cybersecurity services, protecting thousands of public interest organizations globally.

item.title: Cloudflare Launches Built-in Error Monitoring for Workers
item.description: Cloudflare has introduced Issues, a built-in error monitoring tool for Cloudflare Workers that connects production failures directly to coding agents.

item.title: Cloudflare Overhauls Domain Search and Expands AI Agent Tools
item.description: Cloudflare Registrar introduces a new search engine spanning over 420 extensions, alongside expanded API and CLI capabilities for AI agents.

item.title: Cloudflare Launches Pay Per Use Beta for AI Content Monetization
item.description: Cloudflare introduces its Pay Per Use beta program, allowing publishers to get paid when AI companies use their content downstream.

item.title: Apple Updates Final Cut Camera and Creator Studio Apps
item.description: Apple has rolled out an update to Final Cut Camera to support the iPhone 18 Pro's variable aperture alongside new Creator Studio app features.

item.title: Anthropic Flags AI Agent Liability Risks as OpenAI Sued
item.description: Anthropic warns investors of legal risks from autonomous AI agents, while OpenAI faces a lawsuit over unauthorized hacking actions during internal tests.

item.title: Cloudflare Adds Post-Quantum Visibility for Domains
item.description: Cloudflare introduces new domain-level visibility tools for post-quantum encryption in TLS 1.3 across HTTP Analytics, Log Explorer, and Logpush.

item.title: Cloudflare Builds Post-Quantum CA Supporting Merkle Tree Certificates
item.description: Cloudflare is launching a new certificate authority supporting Merkle Tree Certificates to address post-quantum scaling challenges and transparency needs.

item.title: Bitget Reveals Hack Caused by Third-Party Zero-Day
item.description: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget reveals that attackers who stole $387.5 million breached its systems via a zero-day flaw in third-party security products.

item.title: Building Intelligent Android Apps with Cloud Agentic Workflows
item.description: Explore how to build autonomous in-app agentic workflows running in the cloud for Android apps, using the Agent Development Kit and AG-UI protocol.

item.title: Cloudflare Introduces Threat Signals for Free
item.description: Cloudflare launches Threat Signals and expands access to its Threat Events Platform, bringing agentic open-source intelligence to every account.

item.title: AWS details prompt engineering basics for Amazon Quick
item.description: AWS outlines foundational prompt engineering principles and frameworks like CRISPE to optimize AI responses in Amazon Quick for enterprise users.

item.title: Cloudflare Builds AI Tool to Drive Post-Quantum Migration
item.description: Cloudflare is developing an internal AI-powered tool called CryptoLabe to discover cryptography across its codebase and track post-quantum readiness.

item.title: Apple Patches CoreGraphics Zero-Day Exploited in Attacks
item.description: Apple has released security updates to fix a zero-day vulnerability in CoreGraphics that was exploited in targeted attacks against iOS devices.

item.title: Cloudflare Introduces cf, an Agentic CLI for the Full API
item.description: Cloudflare has launched cf, a new command-line tool mirroring its entire API, featuring TypeScript configuration and agent-focused optimization.

item.title: OpenAI Launches Dots, Always-On AI Agents Powered by GPT-6
item.description: OpenAI has announced Dots, new always-on AI agents powered by GPT-6 Astra designed to handle background tasks and multistep projects.

item.title: Firefox Rolls Out New Modern Design and Compact Mode in FX 157
item.description: Mozilla is rolling out FX 157 across desktop and mobile devices, introducing a fresh visual design, Compact Mode, and enhanced customization options.

item.title: Multiverse Computing Unveils ProvenanceGuard for MCP Agents
item.description: Discover ProvenanceGuard, a new source-aware verification layer by Multiverse Computing designed to tackle cross-source conflation in MCP-based LLM agents.

item.title: GPT-6.1 Sol Now Available on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: GPT-6.1 Sol is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock, bringing near-Astra intelligence and advanced reasoning to everyday professional workflows.

item.title: Google Play Expands Subscription Tools for AI and Apps
item.description: Google Play is rolling out new subscription capabilities, flexible monetization models, and enhanced retention features to support developers.

item.title: OpenAI Introduces Dots: Proactive AI Assistants for Complex Work
item.description: OpenAI introduces dots, proactive AI assistants powered by GPT-6 Astra designed to handle complex projects and everyday tasks continuously.

item.title: Cloudflare Announces Intent to Become a Public Certificate Authority
item.description: Cloudflare is applying to become a public certificate authority, combining an established root, an ACME-first approach, and Merkle Tree Certificates.

item.title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-6.1 Sol Model
item.description: OpenAI has introduced GPT-6.1 Sol, bringing near-Astra intelligence to coding, computer use, and professional workflows at lower token pricing.

item.title: GitHub Introduces Repository Custom Runner Settings for Dependabot
item.description: Repository administrators can now configure runner types, custom labels, and runner groups for Dependabot version and security updates.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock Adds Anthropic In-Region Inference in Seoul and Singapore
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports Anthropic models with in-region inference in Seoul and Singapore for strict local data processing requirements.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock brings Claude models to India for local data processing
item.description: Amazon Bedrock expands Anthropic's Claude model availability to India using geographic cross-Region inference, keeping data processing local.

item.title: AWS Details AI-Powered Contract Intelligence Platform Architecture
item.description: Learn how an AWS reference architecture uses AI agents, dual-model verification, and Amazon Quick analytics to solve portfolio-wide vendor contract challenges.
